page.notes: Uncertain readings: "Pol[?]entiam" (damaged letter), "jastantes" (ligature possibly ct), "Tufillanimitati" (first letter unclear), and "expectasses" (ending unclear). Greek running head is set in mixed Greek and Latin letters as it appears on the scan. Long s was normalised to s throughout. The left edge fragments are show-through or the neighbouring page and are omitted. The page ends mid-sentence, so the following text continues on the next page.
